import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/worldbank_education_gdp.csv')

# Identify the relevant columns
# Labor force participation rate (modeled ILO estimate)

# School enrollment, primary (percentage gross)
primary_enrollment = df.filter(regex='School enrollment, primary.*').columns[0]

# School enrollment, secondary (percentage gross)
secondary_enrollment = df.filter(regex='School enrollment, secondary.*').columns[0]

# Exports of goods and services (annual percentage growth)

# Extract the relevant data
X = df[[labor_force_participation, primary_enrollment, secondary_enrollment]]
y = df[export_growth]

# Create a linear regression model
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)

# Get the coefficients
coefficients = model.coef_

primary_enrollment = df[df['Series Name'] == 'School enrollment, primary (percentage gross)']
secondary_enrollment = df[df['Series Name'] == 'School enrollment, secondary (percentage gross)']
export_growth = df[df['Series Name'] == 'Exports of goods and services (annual percentage growth)']

# Extract the relevant data
labor_force_participation_values = labor_force_participation.iloc[:, 4:].values
primary_enrollment_values = primary_enrollment.iloc[:, 4:].values
secondary_enrollment_values = secondary_enrollment.iloc[:, 4:].values
export_growth_values = export_growth.iloc[:, 4:].values

y = export_growth_values

model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)

# Get the coefficients
coefficients = model.coef_
coefficients

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/worldbank_education_gdp.csv')

# Filter rows for the relevant indicators
labor_force_participation = df[df['Series Name'] == 'Labor force participation rate, total (percentage of total population ages 15+) (modeled ILO estimate)']
primary_enrollment = df[df['Series Name'] == 'School enrollment, primary (percentage gross)']
secondary_enrollment = df[df['Series Name'] == 'School enrollment, secondary (percentage gross)']
export_growth = df[df['Series Name'] == 'Exports of goods and services (annual percentage growth)']

# Extract the relevant data
labor_force_participation_values = labor_force_participation.iloc[:, 4:].values
primary_enrollment_values = primary_enrollment.iloc[:, 4:].values
secondary_enrollment_values = secondary_enrollment.iloc[:, 4:].values
export_growth_values = export_growth.iloc[:, 4:].values

# Impute missing values with the mean
imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy='mean')
labor_force_participation_values = imputer.fit_transform(labor_force_participation_values)
primary_enrollment_values = imputer.fit_transform(primary_enrollment_values)
secondary_enrollment_values = imputer.fit_transform(secondary_enrollment_values)
export_growth_values = imputer.fit_transform(export_growth_values)

# Combine the data for regression
X = np.hstack((labor_force_participation_values, primary_enrollment_values, secondary_enrollment_values))
y = export_growth_values

# Create a linear regression model
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)

# Get the coefficients
coefficients = model.coef_
coefficients
